World Cup 2014: James Rodriguez's six World Cup goals. **Colombia forward James Rodriguez won the Golden Boot for finishing as the top scorer at the 2014 Fifa World Cup.**. The 23-year-old, who plays for Monaco, scored six goals in five matches as his side reached the quarter-finals, where they lost to hosts Brazil. Rodriguez finished ahead of Germany forward Thomas Muller, who netted five goals as his side won the tournament. title: What is the Golden Boot? History, winners of the World Cup award – NBC 6 South Florida
content: # What is the Golden Boot? History, winners and more about the World Cup award. When a player competes in the World Cup, one goal is on their mind: win. ## What is the World Cup Golden Boot? The Golden Boot is awarded to the top scorer at each World Cup. There is also a Silver Boot and Bronze Boot to the second and third top scorers, respectively. Kylian Mbappé and Lionel Messi competed not only for the World Cup trophy, but the Golden Boot when France and Argentina faced off in the 2022 final. Mbappé's eight goals were tied with Brazil's Ronaldo (2002) for the most ever by a Golden Boot winner. Germany’s Thomas Müller nearly pulled off the feat in 2014 — he won the Golden Boot in 2010 and the Silver Boot in 2014, finishing one goal behind Colombia’s James Rodriguez. ## What is the record for most goals in a World Cup?
